findings.reason: a control that cannot go red does not show the guard fires, and this is the only negative control §2 declares, so the plan must state that the test derives the O-point from psi (or name a field proven O-point-free) for the control to be one.
findings.text: §2's new negative control (lines 102–104) substitutes only psi with "the vacuum field of that slice's coil currents", but §2's own account (line 76) makes the O-point the stored `global_quantities.magnetic_axis`, a field the control leaves unchanged, so the guarded "O-point inside the last closed surface" assertion need not fail and the control may never go red; where instead the test derives the O-point from psi, the §2-cited finder `latent/topology.py` `read_topology` documents in its own docstring that a field with coil currents but no plasma current still carries PF-coil O-points, so a vacuum coil field is not established to be O-point-free

findings.reason: §2's only declared dependency does not supply an E101154 psi grid, so a node dispatched on §2 waits on a rung that does not deliver the psi its done-when measures, and the plan must re-scope §2's psi source or its dependency.
findings.text: §2 says the machine map's §7 "reads SELENE's equilibria from the facility's equilibrium database (EQDB) and maps psi on its grid, the boundary and the profiles into equilibrium", but jt60sa-machine-map §7 says its "psi bindings and the reference loader's psi and axis reduction are scoped against E101011 alone", takes that psi from a G-EQDSK file copied under /work, and takes only boundary, X-point, plasma centre and plasma current from PSRC, which "carries no flux grid"
